description: Checks codes against the current official releases, which change every year, and reports whether each is valid, billable or terminated today. Returns the official descriptor for ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes, HCPCS Level II service/supply/drug codes and HCPCS modifiers found on an Explanation of Benefits or medical bill, plus the chapter, a plain-language note where KeepMD has one, the data version, and licensing notices for CPT, dental, NDC and X12 remark codes (which are recognized but not described). Use it for any code a user asks about, including common ones such as Z00.00, 99213, J0696 or CO-45. Accepts every code from a statement in one call.

codes.description: Codes exactly as printed on the statement, for example ["E11.9", "J0696", "99213", "CO-45", "GT"]. Up to 50 per call; one call per statement.

system.description: Which code set to assume. auto tries ICD-10-CM, HCPCS Level II and the licensed patterns. Use carc or rarc for remark/reason codes, modifier for two-character modifiers.

name: lookup_codes
title: Look up EOB codes
